identity_handling: left join on TransactionID; the 75.58% of transactions with no identity record are KEPT, flagged by a binary `has_identity` feature, and their 40 identity columns imputed by the training-window median like any other missing entry. No row is dropped.
split: temporal on TransactionDT (a time delta in seconds, used as an ordering variable only): train = rows with TransactionDT <= the 75th percentile (11246620 s = day 129.2 from the first transaction), test = the remainder. Same 75/25 temporal proportion as the BAF arm. TransactionDT is not a feature.
value_definition: TransactionAmt, the observed transaction amount. This is a REAL monetary field, so the value-weighted recall of this column is a genuine value metric -- unlike the BAF column (proposed_credit_limit, an exposure proxy) and the vehicle column (price-band midpoints).
missingness_rule: columns entirely missing in the training window are dropped; every other missing entry is set to the training-window median. The same imputed matrix is given to all five detectors so that the comparison is on equal information.
